verdict.rationale: dLocal's first-party docs describe a public API used across its products. Merchants call it to build their own payment forms, save cards and charge by `card_id`, get Pix parameters back, and create wallet enrollments for direct charges. Developers get sandbox credentials, can test API behavior with status codes in the request body, and receive signed webhook notifications. Missing for 10: an excerpt from the API reference showing endpoints and authentication, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on confirmation of driving the API.
